findings.description: The regression check compares the signed delta to max_drop directly, so it flags any run whose hit@5 is below max_drop, including unchanged or improved runs. The comparison should test whether the drop, -delta, exceeds max_drop.
findings.rationale: Trigger: run `eval --compare baseline.json --max-drop 0.03` where hit@5_delta is 0.0 or +0.02 (no drop, or an improvement). Mechanism: 0.0 < 0.03 and 0.02 < 0.03 are true, so regression() returns a failure message and main.py raises SystemExit. Impact: the CI gate fails on runs that did not regress, and it does so for any run that is not clearly better than the baseline by more than max_drop.
